Build the research navigator foundations: frozen cohorts, verifiable implementer handoffs, field-level completeness, freshness clocks, release/distribution identity and current-input attestation. Eight components are independently accepted and integrated: PR-001/002/003/004/005/007/085/086. PR-006 and PR-008 remain in correction after independent review; this checkpoint publishes their evidence and the reviewed PR-009 scope without integrating their implementations.

The latest accepted composition passed all ten local release-gate stages on the first attempt with one build. Both jobs in [CI run 34622150511](https://github.com/ajhcs/ushso/actions/runs/34622150511) checked out tree `a9d9bca698ffc403a9ad1b82a8c8328af01146aa`. [Acceptance and complete gate/CI evidence](https://github.com/ajhcs/ushso/tree/ded4231005ae3c859158e75345c0499aae2a2fe4/verification/research-program/bootstrap/components-e6da2e2) preserve exact identities and prior failures.

- [PR-006 independent review](https://github.com/ajhcs/ushso/tree/9e00d4e09514e1dd30672e19a3cbef4171955b00/verification/research-program/bootstrap/pr006-review-5d8a8dd): seven required/type checks and ten engine probes pass. Two fixture ID-matching probes and four mobile description-reference scenarios fail; desktop filter and Sources cases pass. Full logs, DOM snapshots and screenshots are retained.
- [PR-008 correction review](https://github.com/ajhcs/ushso/tree/9e00d4e09514e1dd30672e19a3cbef4171955b00/verification/research-program/bootstrap/pr008-review-a50f5fa): all eight required checks and the original 21 semantic cases pass, with all 73 artifact bindings verified. Six new cases expose incomplete or contradictory parent relationships accepted by the new context resolver. Corrections remain assigned; original failures and successful controls are retained.
- [PR-009 narrowed scope and operating inputs](https://github.com/ajhcs/ushso/tree/12e88769677df1cb54022a13c1b429f70fc71346/verification/research-program/bootstrap/pr009-scope-20260911) preserve the exact retained Census 200-HTML failure through hash-bound gzip. A [separate scope review](https://github.com/ajhcs/ushso/tree/9e00d4e09514e1dd30672e19a3cbef4171955b00/verification/research-program/bootstrap/pr009-scope-independent-review-12e8876) found no weakened thresholds. Pure policy/receipt work waits for PR-008 acceptance; documented prices and publication size do not establish actual cost or the cheapest measured topology. Connector edits also require an additive WP5 successor.

The validated plan remains 86 PRs and 258 planned commits. All R01–R16 requirements remain unaccepted; frozen cohorts and the 3434/3430/4 corpus partition are unchanged. Scientific qualification, current successor approvals, real participants, actual refresh cycles and sustained observation remain pending. Main and production are unchanged.
